name: John The Baptist
overview: John the Baptist is presented in Scripture as the divinely appointed forerunner who prepares the way for the coming of the Lord, fulfilling the prophecy of Isaiah as the voice crying in the wilderness. His birth was foretold by an angel to Zacharias, emphasizing God's sovereign plan. John’s ministry in Judea was a direct fulfillment of Malachi’s promise of a messenger sent to prepare the way for the Messiah. Jesus Himself affirmed John's unparalleled role among those born of women, highlighting his unique place in redemptive history while pointing to the greater reality of the kingdom of heaven.
